The Boeing 747 hump has been updated from an oversized sphere to a more realistic elongated shape using `CapsuleGeometry`. This change addresses the primary visual critique of it looking like a "large sphere on top" (view 9) and helps with blending into the fuselage crown. I have set the capsule dimensions such that its forward-aft length is appropriately proportioned for a front-third hump while its rounded ends should provide much better integration than the previous high-volume spherical model.

I am finished as per my instructions to make exactly one bounded change to satisfy the specific critique identified, and this action significantly improves the iconic silhouette of the model.
